items.title: 不只省電，災難來時更不能斷線：台灣醫療怎麼用 SusQI 撐住病患？
items.summary: 醫院的發電機能撐過颱風夜，不代表病人的治療不會中斷。道路淹水、高溫、停電與封路同時發生時，洗腎病患可能無法抵達醫院，長輩也可能在家中病情惡化。台灣醫療的節能成果已有目共睹，但省電成效與災時照護韌性並不相等。本文介紹「永續品質改善」（SusQI）如何把減碳與病人安全放在一起評估，並以血液透析為例，說明如何從單一照護路徑建立防災備援。

items.title: ESRS-40a: CSRD reporting standards for certain non-EU companies
items.summary: Reporting standards to be used for financial years beginning on or after 1 January 2028 (reporting in 2029) The Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive is a directive from the European Union that expands sustainability reporting standards and requirements.

items.title: Chart: A record two-thirds of car sales in China are now electric vehicles
items.summary: For the first time, new-energy vehicles (NEVs) made up 67% of new car sales in China in September, according to the latest data from the China Passenger Car Association (CPCA).

items.title: European Parliament backs three-year delay to EU methane rules
items.summary: The European Parliament has voted to delay methane reporting requirements for oil, gas and coal imports by three years, extending the timeline beyond the one-year postponement proposed by the European Commission.

items.title: ON TUESDAY: How AI can accelerate investment in climate solutions
items.summary: Join us on 27 October for an edie webinar exploring how artificial intelligence (AI), market intelligence and human expertise can help businesses identify credible climate investment opportunities and secure the financial backing needed to turn sustainability ambitions into action.

items.title: Google ordered to halt Finnish data centres after 400,000 trees felled
items.summary: Authorities ordered Google to pause development of two of its data centres in Finland following claims the tech giant failed to conduct the necessary assessments before felling 400,000 trees.

items.title: Demand for green skills is growing twice as fast as global supply, LinkedIn finds
items.summary: Demand for green skills is growing twice as fast as supply globally, creating a workforce gap that could slow climate action, energy infrastructure projects and economic growth, according to LinkedIn.

items.title: Updated: Sustainability leadership moves
items.summary: As corporate sustainability matures, some long-time leaders are leaving the profession, while others are tackling a broader set of responsibilities following reorganizations or layoffs.

items.title: Burnham’s first Budget: What would ‘good’ look like for the green economy?
items.summary: Chancellor John Healey is set to deliver Prime Minister Andy Burnham's first Budget on 28 October.
